0.risk: Elasticsearch 2.3 is end-of-life and contains numerous known CVEs including remote code execution and privilege escalation vulnerabilities. It no longer receives security patches.
0.remediation: Upgrade elasticsearch_version to a supported version (e.g., "7.10" or migrate to OpenSearch "2.x") by changing the elasticsearch_version attribute.

7.issue: Overly permissive domain access policy — wildcard principal and wildcard actions
7.risk: The policy grants es:* (all Elasticsearch actions) to Principal AWS "*" (any unauthenticated or authenticated AWS identity on the internet), effectively making the domain publicly writable and readable by anyone.
7.remediation: Replace the wildcard principal identifiers = ["*"] with specific IAM role or user ARNs that require access, restrict actions from es:* to only the minimum required actions (e.g., es:ESHttpGet), and scope resources to the specific domain ARN instead of "*".
